description: AND, OR and XOR gates of two inputs each and a NOT gate, all polyphonic, over 0-10V logic where anything above 1V counts as high

params.text: Chooses how XOR combines the channels of a single input: off counts odd parity, on gives high only when exactly one channel is high

inputs.text: One of the two signals that gate combines; patch this one alone and the gate is applied across all the channels of this input instead, giving a single-channel result
The other of the two signals that gate combines; patch this one alone and its channels are inverted to the output
The signal the NOT gate inverts, channel by channel

outputs.text: The result of that gate, 10V for high and 0V for low; with neither input patched it stays at 0V
Each channel of the NOT input inverted; with nothing patched to that input it stays at 10V

notes: a monophonic input is combined with every channel of a polyphonic one; two polyphonic inputs are matched channel for channel, and the unmatched channels are dropped
